title: Onboard aurora-spark-13b v1.3: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR adds aurora-spark-13b v1.3 to the model registry with updated metadata, validated performance profiles for common inference footprints, and an automated changelog entry pipeline. Motivation: customers running Aurora variants reported regression under 8k context; v1.3 fixes tokenizer mismatch and provides optimized perf profiles for 16k and 32k KV-cache behavior. Changes include: - canonical metadata JSON for v1.3 (architecture, tokenizer, parameter counts, recommended quantization modes, compatibility tags) - perf_profiles.yaml with throughput/latency targets measured across A100-40G, A100-80G, and RTX6000; includes preferred pipeline configs (batch size heuristics, KV cache warmup thresholds) - small test harness to validate model metadata and perf profile parsing - changelog automation: integration in tools/changelog that generates release notes from model registry diffs and attaches Redwood-formatted release notes to Linear ticket. Checklist: [x] metadata validated against schema [x] perf profiles measured and reviewed [x] changelog automation integrated and smoke-tested [x] unit tests added [x] documentation updated (model page + release notes template). Manual testing: locally ran inference smoke tests with quantized and FP16 variants; validated tokenization parity against reference tokenizer; measured steady-state throughput for 2048 and 8192 seq lengths (results captured in perf_profiles.yaml). Link to Linear ENG-2234 for rollout plan. Notes for reviewers: focus on perf profile assumptions (warmup/sample sizes) and changelog formatting (Markdown front-matter and Linear linking).
